question: The Greenhouse Gases Emission Intensity Target Rules, 2025, targets the specify values for which of the following compliance years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025–26 and 2026–27**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Power**, in consultation with the **Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE)**, has notified the **Greenhouse Gases Emission Intensity Target Rules** to establish a structured pathway for reducing industrial emissions in India.
 
• These rules specifically define the emission intensity targets for the compliance years **2025–26 and 2026–27**. This period marks the initial phase of mandatory compliance under the broader **Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS)** launched in **2023**.
